{{Infobox | title = BITwiki Lua Module Specifications | description = Complete Lua module specifications for template validation and SMW integration | type = specification | author = Hyperion (a0.b8-profile) | created = 2026-02-13 | version = 1.0.0 | epistemic_status = Established | confidence = Established | license = CC-BY-SA-4.0 | modified = 2026-02-13 | ontology = entity_type: specification domain: smw-technical scope: lua-modules | workflow = state: Complete phase: Phase_1 | tags = - lua - modules - validation - smw - templates }} {{Documentation}} [[Category:BITwiki Schema]] [[Category:Lua Modules]] [[Category:Technical Specifications]] = BITwiki Lua Module Specifications = == Overview This document specifies Lua modules for BITwiki template validation, epistemic status management, and SMW integration. These modules provide runtime validation, error handling, and semantic enrichment. == Module Architecture ``` Module:ValidatorBase # Core validation framework ├── Module:EpistemicValidator # Epistemic status validation ├── Module:PropertyValidator # SMW property validation ├── Module:TemplateValidator # Template-specific validation └── Module:QueryHelper # SMW query utilities ``` == Module:ValidatorBase === Purpose Centralized validation framework providing common validation functions. === Code ```lua -- Module:ValidatorBase -- Provides base validation functions for BITwiki templates local p = {} -- Validation error levels local ERROR_LEVELS = { CRITICAL = 4, -- Prevents template rendering HIGH = 3, -- Shows warning, renders with defaults MEDIUM = 2, -- Logs warning, renders normally LOW = 1, -- Silent logging only INFO = 0 -- Informational only } -- Epistemic status hierarchy local EPISTEMIC_HIERARCHY = { Axiomatic = 1.0, Established = 0.9, Developing = 0.7, Preliminary = 0.5, Speculative = 0.3 } -- Validate epistemic status function p.validateEpistemicStatus(status) if EPISTEMIC_HIERARCHY[status] then return true, EPISTEMIC_HIERARCHY[status] else return false, 0, "Invalid epistemic status: " .. tostring(status) end end -- Validate confidence score function p.validateConfidence(confidence) local num = tonumber(confidence) if num and num >= 0 and num <= 1 then return true, num else return false, 0, "Confidence must be between 0.0 and 1.0" end end -- Validate required field function p.validateRequired(value, fieldName) if value and value ~= "" then return true, value else return false, nil, "Required field missing: " .. fieldName end end -- Validate URL format function p.validateURL(url) if url:match("^https?://") then return true, url else return false, nil, "Invalid URL format: " .. url end end -- Validate date format (ISO 8601) function p.validateDate(dateStr) if dateStr:match("^%d%d%d%d%-%d%d%-%d%d$") then return true, dateStr else return false, nil, "Invalid date format. Use YYYY-MM-DD" end end -- Generate validation report function p.generateReport(errors, warnings) local report = {} table.insert(report, "{| class=\"wikitable\"") table.insert(report, "! Level !! Message") for _, error in ipairs(errors) do table.insert(report, string.format("|-\n| %s || %s", error.level, error.message)) end table.insert(report, "|}") return table.concat(report, "\n") end return p ``` == Module:EpistemicValidator === Purpose Validates epistemic metadata and enforces epistemic constraints. === Code ```lua -- Module:EpistemicValidator -- Validates epistemic status, confidence, and provenance local p = {} local ValidatorBase = require("Module:ValidatorBase") -- Epistemic status constraints local STATUS_CONSTRAINTS = { Axiomatic = { minConfidence = 1.0, requiresEvidence = false }, Established = { minConfidence = 0.8, requiresEvidence = true }, Developing = { minConfidence = 0.6, requiresEvidence = true }, Preliminary = { minConfidence = 0.4, requiresEvidence = true }, Speculative = { minConfidence = 0.0, requiresEvidence = false } } -- Validate complete epistemic record function p.validateEpistemicRecord(args) local errors = {} local warnings = {} -- Validate status local statusValid, statusValue, statusError = ValidatorBase.validateEpistemicStatus(args.epistemic_status) if not statusValid then table.insert(errors, { level = "CRITICAL", message = statusError }) return false, errors, warnings end -- Validate confidence local confValid, confValue, confError = ValidatorBase.validateConfidence(args.confidence) if not confValid then table.insert(errors, { level = "HIGH", message = confError }) else -- Check confidence matches status constraints local constraints = STATUS_CONSTRAINTS[args.epistemic_status] if confValue < constraints.minConfidence then table.insert(warnings, { level = "MEDIUM", message = string.format("Confidence %.2f below %s threshold (%.2f)", confValue, args.epistemic_status, constraints.minConfidence) }) end end -- Check evidence requirement local constraints = STATUS_CONSTRAINTS[args.epistemic_status] if constraints.requiresEvidence and (not args.evidence or args.evidence == "") then table.insert(errors, { level = "HIGH", message = args.epistemic_status .. " status requires evidence" }) end return #errors == 0, errors, warnings end -- Get epistemic display class function p.getEpistemicClass(status) local classes = { Axiomatic = "epistemic-axiomatic", Established = "epistemic-established", Developing = "epistemic-developing", Preliminary = "epistemic-preliminary", Speculative = "epistemic-speculative" } return classes[status] or "epistemic-unknown" end return p ``` == Module:TemplateValidator === Purpose Template-specific validation logic for BITwiki infoboxes. === Code ```lua -- Module:TemplateValidator -- Template-specific validation for BITwiki local p = {} local ValidatorBase = require("Module:ValidatorBase") local EpistemicValidator = require("Module:EpistemicValidator") -- Infobox Concept validation rules local INFOBOX_CONCEPT_RULES = { required = { "title", "type", "epistemic_status" }, recommended = { "description", "confidence", "author" }, optional = { "version", "created", "modified", "tags" }, typeConstraints = { type = { "Concept", "Idea", "Implementation", "Project", "Framework" }, epistemic_status = { "Axiomatic", "Established", "Developing", "Preliminary", "Speculative" } } } -- Validate Infobox Concept function p.validateInfoboxConcept(args) local errors = {} local warnings = {} -- Check required fields for _, field in ipairs(INFOBOX_CONCEPT_RULES.required) do local valid, _, err = ValidatorBase.validateRequired(args[field], field) if not valid then table.insert(errors, { level = "CRITICAL", message = err }) end end -- Check type constraints if args.type then local validType = false for _, allowed in ipairs(INFOBOX_CONCEPT_RULES.typeConstraints.type) do if args.type == allowed then validType = true break end end if not validType then table.insert(errors, { level = "HIGH", message = "Invalid type: " .. args.type }) end end -- Validate epistemic record local epistemicValid, epistemicErrors, epistemicWarnings = EpistemicValidator.validateEpistemicRecord(args) for _, err in ipairs(epistemicErrors) do table.insert(errors, err) end for _, warn in ipairs(epistemicWarnings) do table.insert(warnings, warn) end return #errors == 0, errors, warnings end -- Generate validation banner function p.generateValidationBanner(errors, warnings) if #errors == 0 and #warnings == 0 then return "" end local banner = {} table.insert(banner, "
") if #errors > 0 then table.insert(banner, "
") table.insert(banner, "Validation Errors:") table.insert(banner, "
    ") for _, err in ipairs(errors) do table.insert(banner, "
  • " .. err.message .. "
    • ") end table.insert(banner, "
") end if #warnings > 0 then table.insert(banner, "
") table.insert(banner, "Warnings:") table.insert(banner, "
    ") for _, warn in ipairs(warnings) do table.insert(banner, "
  • " .. warn.message .. "
    • ") end table.insert(banner, "
") end table.insert(banner, "
") return table.concat(banner, "\n") end return p ``` == Module:QueryHelper === Purpose SMW query utilities for dynamic content generation. === Code ```lua -- Module:QueryHelper -- SMW query utilities for BITwiki local p = {} -- Build epistemic filter query function p.buildEpistemicQuery(status, limit) limit = limit or 50 local query = string.format( "[[Has epistemic status::%s]]\n" .. "|format=list\n" .. "|limit=%d\n" .. "|sort=Has confidence\n" .. "|order=descending", status, limit ) return query end -- Build related concepts query function p.buildRelatedQuery(concept, relationship) local query = string.format( "[[%s]]\n" .. "[[Has relationship::%s]]\n" .. "|format=ul\n" .. "|limit=20", concept, relationship ) return query end -- Build author attribution query function p.buildAuthorQuery(author, limit) limit = limit or 100 local query = string.format( "[[Has author::%s]]\n" .. "|format=table\n" .. "|limit=%d\n" .. "|?Has epistemic status\n" .. "|?Has confidence", author, limit ) return query end return p ``` == CSS Integration ```css /* BITwiki Validation Styles */ .validation-banner { border: 1px solid #ddd; margin: 1em 0; padding: 0.5em; } .validation-errors { background-color: #fee; border-left: 4px solid #c00; padding: 0.5em; margin-bottom: 0.5em; } .validation-warnings { background-color: #ffe; border-left: 4px solid #cc0; padding: 0.5em; } /* Epistemic status indicators */ .epistemic-axiomatic { border-left: 4px solid #000; } .epistemic-established { border-left: 4px solid #0c0; } .epistemic-developing { border-left: 4px solid #00c; } .epistemic-preliminary { border-left: 4px solid #c80; } .epistemic-speculative { border-left: 4px solid #c0c; } ``` == Deployment Instructions # Create modules in MediaWiki: `Module:ValidatorBase`, `Module:EpistemicValidator`, etc. # Add CSS to `MediaWiki:Common.css` # Update templates to use `{{#invoke:TemplateValidator|validateInfoboxConcept|...}}` # Test with sample pages before full deployment == References * [[Template Validation Report v2]] * [[SMW Property Types Complete]] * [[BITwiki Ontology Index]] * MediaWiki Lua Reference: https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Extension:Scribunto/Lua_reference_manual
